name: Cscript.exe
description: Binary used to execute scripts in Windows
summary: Execute VBScript and JScript files from the console
Execute scripts stored in alternate data streams
Enable WinRM with winrm.vbs as a backup persistence mechanism
Run scripts from a Windows service for persistence

attack_relationships.description: During Operation CuckooBees, the threat actors enabled WinRM over HTTP/HTTPS as a backup persistence mechanism using the following command: `cscript //nologo "C:\Windows\System32\winrm.vbs" set winrm/config/service@{EnableCompatibilityHttpsListener="true"}`.

STARWHALE has the ability to create the following Windows service to establish persistence on an infected host: `sc create Windowscarpstss binpath= "cmd.exe /c cscript.exe c:\windows\system32\w7_1.wsf humpback_whale" start= "auto" obj= "LocalSystem"`.

associated_commands.intent: Run a VBS script, one of the process arguments listed for the WannaCry ransomware.
Run a remote JScript file from an attacker-controlled server after exploiting CVE-2017-11882.
Discovery: run the actor's custom VBS reconnaissance script and save the results to a text file.
Run the FIN7 JScript first-stage script, saved with a .txt extension and launched by the .xsl file, that gathers host information through WMI queries.
Run the STARWHALE Windows Script File backdoor with the argument humpback__whale.

associated_commands.command: sc create Windowscarpstss binpath= "cmd.exe /c cscript.exe c:\\windows\\system32\\w7_1.wsf humpback__whale" start= "auto" obj= "LocalSystem"
associated_commands.intent: Create a Windows service that runs the STARWHALE script as LocalSystem at boot, because the malware has no persistence of its own.
Run a VBScript dropped after the attacker gained AnyDesk access; it starts a PowerShell command and then the AutoIt DarkGate payload.
associated_commands.source_name: Trend Micro DarkGate Teams Vishing December 2024

associated_commands.intent: Download a Cobalt Strike payload disguised as a .png file from the attackers' compromised web server into C:\users\public\downloads. The report prints two more commands that differ only in file names (2.png and 3.png).
associated_commands.source_name: Sophos MDR Mimic Ransomware STAC6451 August 2024

associated_commands.intent: Run the GootLoader second-stage JavaScript, which spawns PowerShell.
associated_commands.source_name: Sophos GootLoader Bengal Cat Campaign November 2024

associated_commands.intent: Remotely copy the CRASHOVERRIDE payload DLL to another host with a script, using captured credentials. The slide prints <TargetIP 1> as a placeholder for the real address.
associated_commands.source_name: Dragos CRASHOVERRIDE Anatomy of an Attack October 2018

associated_commands.command: cscript C:\Backinfo\sqlc.vbs <TargetIP 1> "-c" "sc config ImapiService binPath= 'C:\Delta\svchost.exe C:\Delta\ 104.dll 104.ini' start= auto && sc start ImapiService"
associated_commands.intent: Run a remote command on another host through a script, reconfiguring a service so that it launches the CRASHOVERRIDE payload, then start it. The slide prints <TargetIP 1> as a placeholder.
associated_commands.source_name: Dragos CRASHOVERRIDE Anatomy of an Attack October 2018

attack_detection_strategies.name: Behavioral Detection of Visual Basic Execution (VBS/VBA/VBScript)

analytics.description: Detects execution of VB-based scripts or macros (VBS/VBA/VBScript) through cscript.exe/wscript.exe, Office-based process chains, or HTA usage. Focuses on chained behavior: Office or HTML container spawns script host > script host spawns PowerShell, network connections, or process injection.

attack_detection_strategies.name: Cross-Platform Detection of JavaScript Execution Abuse

analytics.description: Detects JavaScript execution through WSH (wscript.exe, cscript.exe) or HTA (mshta.exe), particularly when spawned from Office macros, web browsers, or abnormal user paths. Correlates script execution with outbound network activity or system modification.

mitigations.name: Disable or Remove Feature or Program
mitigations.description: Turn off or restrict access to unneeded VB components.

mitigations.name: Execution Prevention
mitigations.description: Use application control where appropriate. VBA macros obtained from the Internet, based on the file's Mark of the Web (MOTW) attribute, may be blocked from executing in Office applications (ex: Access, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, and Word) by default starting in Windows Version 2203.

mitigations.name: Restrict Web-Based Content
mitigations.description: Script blocking extensions can help prevent the execution of scripts and HTA files that may commonly be used during the exploitation process. For malicious code served up through ads, adblockers can help prevent that code from executing in the first place.

mitigations.name: Behavior Prevention on Endpoint
mitigations.description: On Windows 10, enable Attack Surface Reduction (ASR) rules to prevent Visual Basic scripts from executing potentially malicious downloaded content.
